name: Cakes by Michelle
address: 698 SW Port St Lucie Blvd, Port Saint Lucie, FL 34953

reviewSamples.author: Lena
reviewSamples.text: Made a dessert table with sprinkles matching our wedding colors. Taste, communication, and professionalism were great.

reviewSamples.author: Kristin
reviewSamples.text: Made crepe cakes and sketched the whole dessert table in advance - guests loved it and none was left over.

reviewSamples.author: Charlie
reviewSamples.text: Friendly service, sample tastings, fair prices, and the cake matched the sketch exactly - even accommodated a guest's nut allergy.

reviewSamples.author: Nicole
reviewSamples.text: Made us a cake on short notice after our previous baker closed, and replaced a lost cake topper the week before the wedding.

research_notes: No Instagram/Facebook profile found anywhere (multiple searches). Old watermark 'www.cakesbymichelle.net' appears on several WeddingWire gallery photos (dated 2013), but that domain no longer resolves (DNS failure) and no live site exists under any cakesbymichelle*.com/.net variant: has_own_site is correctly false. Real published pricing found on the WeddingWire vendor profile: wedding cake buttercream from $5/slice, fondant from $6/slice, cupcakes from $3.50 each; used as-is in content.json (not invented). Address and both reviews sets (discovery dataset + WeddingWire page fetch) agree on phone 772-785-6586 and the 698 SW Port St Lucie Blvd address, confirmed real via WeddingWire's own vendor profile. 10 vendor gallery photos found on WeddingWire; 8 kept (2 excluded for being multi-photo collage grids rather than single clean shots).
